Can you reconcile the metrics on your CV? Your CV reports a 9.5% churn rate, a top 5% risk band capturing 30% of churners, and 60% precision. Assuming the same population and observation period, use 100,000 subscribers to estimate true positives, precision, and recall. Are those figures consistent within rounding?
results.text: With a hundred thousand subscribers and a nine point five percent churn rate, there are ninety-five hundred actual churners. Catching thirty percent of those gives us twenty-eight hundred and fifty true positives. At sixty percent precision, that implies forty-seven hundred and fifty predicted churners, which is four point seven five percent of the population and aligns perfectly with the observed five percent band within rounding.
